transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because I've been making some mistakes at work. I'm a video editor and camera operator, and lately, I just... I keep messing up really basic technical stuff. Things I definitely know how to do. Like, I'll label camera cards wrong, or I'll completely miss a timecode note from a director. The other day I exported a cut for a client and left the wrong lower-third on it, even though I swear I checked it before I hit render. It's... it's kind of starting to scare me, honestly.
Do you often have trouble staying focused, even when you're trying to pay attention?
Um... no, not really. I don't think it's a focus thing. I can usually pay attention fine, I just... I don't know.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I get frustrated when I mess things up at work, but... no, not depressed.
Have you been having trouble with your memory?
No, my memory is fine. I remember things. It's just... those mistakes I mentioned. But I don't forget things.
Have you been drinking more alcohol lately?
No... I haven't. Just... the normal amount, I guess. Nothing's really changed there.
Have you been worrying a lot lately?
No... not really. I don't think I worry any more than anyone else. Just dealing with things as they come, mostly.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
No... I sleep fine. I haven't really noticed any problems with it.
Have you been having trouble finding the right words when you speak?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Does this feel like a real change from how sharp and organized you used to be?
No, not really. I've always kind of been this way, I guess. It doesn't feel like a change.
When you were a child, did teachers or parents often say you were inattentive or easily distracted?

Yeah... I guess so. Even in elementary school, they... they used to move my desk a lot. I was just always getting out of my seat. Or, um, blurting out answers. I guess I'd bother the other kids before I even realized I was doing it. So... yeah.
As an adult, do you still find yourself often acting before thinking or having trouble staying seated when you’re expected to?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. At work, if a meeting runs longer than a few minutes... I usually end up getting up. I'll go get water, or... check a cable, maybe adjust a monitor. Just... finding some excuse to move around instead of staying in my seat like everyone else.
